logo_override.validation_detail: svg 31833 bytes, probed HTTP 200 with content-type image/svg+xml, viewBox 0 0 326 48. The SVG contains exactly two fill values, fill="#ff665e" coral and fill="#3ad4a7" mint green, and no style block, so nothing in it is white-on-transparent. Rendered on a white background and visually confirmed: the full Movetia wordmark with 'mo' in coral and 'vetia' in mint, beside the four-language strapline 'Austausch und Mobilitat / Echanges et mobilite / Scambi e mobilita / Exchange and mobility' in green. Saturated brand colour throughout, so it reads clearly on a light card.
logo_override._award: Swiss-European Mobility Programme (SEMP) - Incoming Mobility to Switzerland

notes: Awarding body per the shard is Movetia, the Swiss agency for exchange and mobility, which implements the Swiss Programme for Erasmus+ on behalf of SERI, and movetia.ch is Movetia's own domain - so its own mark is the correct one and no third-party or Erasmus+ umbrella mark was substituted. Found directly in the markup of the record's own official_source_url: two elements on that page point at https://movetia.ch/assets/static/logos/logo-movetia.svg, one carrying alt="Movetia logo", which is the awarding body naming its own asset. Path naming is German-engineered and the SVG's own class is logo_farbig_mov ('farbig' = full colour), confirming this is the positive full-colour variant rather than a reversed one - and the two-fill analysis plus the render confirm it independently. Rejected alternatives: the page's first img is a src="data:," placeholder with alt="logo", which is an empty inline image and not an asset at all; a second data:image/png;base64 inline tracking-pixel (alt="opens in a new window") is a 1x1 beacon, not a logo; and the full favicon set under /assets/static/favicon/ (apple-icon-precomposed.png, apple-icon-57/60/72/76/114/120/144, android-icon-36/48/72/96/144/192, favicon.ico) is icon-only, with android-icon-192x192.png probed separately at 200 image/png 5626 bytes. Per brief section 2 the full-colour wordmark was preferred over those bare icons, and here both exist so the wordmark wins outright. The three magazine images under /files/04_Magazin/ are editorial photography and were ignored.
